topic: What payload operational challenges arise from dynamic power reallocation under time-varying traffic demands?
response: Dynamic power reallocation under time-varying traffic demands can lead to payload operational challenges such as packet dropping, transmission errors, and reduced system efficiency. This is due to the mismatch between allocated capacity and changing traffic requirements, resulting in parameter mismatch and performance loss.
